Per the FCC SAR testing report.. *The Main antenna (GSM 850/1900MHz / UMTS Band 2/5) (Tx+Rx) appears to be located at the bottom of the phone. *The Sub. antenna (UMTS Band 5) (Rx) appears to be located at the top left of the phone. *The GPS antenna (Rx) is located at the top right of the phone *The BT/Wi-Fi antenna (Tx+Rx) is located at middle left of the phone (under the GPS antenna). *The NFC antenna is integrated into the battery (standard model being B600BC). *AP mode in the 5GHz bands are not supported with the Wi-Fi chip due to a firmware limitation.
